purpose: Test whether native component programs can form executable, bounded, task-independent memory before treating code caching as a new knowledge adaptation method.
mechanism: Retrieve complete program-valued memories by changed capability, admit only native-source programs with verified dependency closure and rendered effects, then freeze those memories into affected tool knowledge. This differs from appending failure-avoidance prose. No new tools, execution hooks, native repair or task answers.
selection: Within each entire archived category, choose the nonempty complete implementation with the fewest UTF-8 code bytes; ties by component name. Do not inspect task outcomes or change selection after dependency results. Exactly two selections; no fall-through to the next shortest component.

memory_budget.reason: Prospective engineering bound, not a paper-mandated threshold or a token equivalence.

checks: Extract all component records from the two archived native responses and verify provenance hashes.
Extract selected code verbatim; inventory imports and runtime/style requirements without changing the source.
Check JavaScript parseability and dependency resolution under the pinned Node from an isolated copy of the existing extension input fixture, with isolated HOME/TMPDIR and no NODE_PATH.
A program is admitted only if its code and all runtime/style dependencies can execute and render its generic advertised effect. Parser/import checks alone cannot establish rendering.

No agent/updater/judge calls in this admission study; no dependency installation or source transformation during this fixed test. Any later shared runtime is a separately declared environment change, not a passing result here.
pass_rule: Both predetermined programs meet the byte bound, existing-runtime execution and rendered-effect requirements. Missing dependencies or unverified rendering mean not_ready, never strategy failure or agent success.
counterfactual_diagnostic: Use only recorded first/last prompt counts to upper-bound direct static-knowledge removal under an unchanged trajectory. State that behavior changes are excluded and tokenization/framing overhead is not measured exactly.
